text:
The series won an Annie Award for Outstanding Achievement for Storyboarding in an Animated Television Production at the 33rd Annie Awards, held in 2006, for the episode "The Deserter" (storyboarded by Lauren MacMullan). This corrects my earlier answer, and it matches the shared team note; I found it in a [Wikipedia storyboarding table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annie_Award_for_Outstanding_Achievement_for_Storyboarding_in_an_Animated_Television/Broadcast_Production), which lists the win under the 33rd (2005-season) entry. Sources conflict on details: one IMDb page credits a different person, and I could not confirm the category wording from the official Annie archive.

CONFIDENCE: 72
